title: config
description: One arm: data/configs/<name>.yaml. What evh run and arm-smoke read. The knobs of the system under test go in `params`, which the adapter interprets; nothing else is read, so an unknown top-level key is a typo.

config_id.description: The arm's identity; runs are named after it.

params.description: Passed to the adapter's call_system() as is. Prices (`usd_per_mtok_in`, `usd_per_mtok_out`) live here.

adapter.description: The adapter file, relative to the config, then the project. Absent: <project>/adapter.py, else the bundled one.

goal.description: The goal_id this arm is measured for (ADR-0002).

round.description: The round of its goal this arm belongs to (ADR-0004, optional): data/rounds/<goal>/<round>.yaml. Needs `goal`.

model_record.description: The model record this arm runs (RFC-020, optional): data/models/<id>.yaml. Its settings go under the config's params (the config wins); `model` comes from its first alias when params give none.

deployment.description: Which of the model record's deployments this arm runs (RFC-021, optional; needs `model_record`): the id of an entry in the record's `deployments`. The run's fingerprint takes the deployment's weights, server and hardware from it.

format.description: The output shape, matched against the goal's output_contract.

hypothesis.description: What this arm is expected to do, written before its run (ADR-0025, optional). A run records it and whether it was committed before the run; pair-test says so. Not part of the fingerprint. Its keys (against, measure, direction better|worse|no-worse, statement, optional items) are checked by validate V20 and by evh run, which say what is wrong in words.

against.description: The config_id this arm is compared with.

measure.description: The metric the prediction is about.

direction.description: better, worse or no-worse (not significantly worse) than `against` on `measure`.

items.description: Optional: a file of item ids expected to flip.
